# Los Angeles Times

> > Historic archives of the Los Angeles Times featuring original reporting on cultural icons, performing arts, and landmark events from the early 20th century.

The Los Angeles Times maintains a digital archive of historic articles dating back over a century, preserving original obituaries, concert reviews, and front-page coverage of significant cultural and historical moments. These archives document the evolution of Los Angeles as a cultural center, particularly through coverage of the LA Philharmonic, Hollywood's golden age, and internationally renowned artists and performers.

## Key Topics

- Los Angeles Philharmonic
- Walter Henry Rothwell
- Philharmonic Auditorium
- Hollywood Bowl
- Harry Houdini
- Lon Chaney
- Isadora Duncan
- John Muir
- Sarah Bernhardt
- Classical music history
- 1920s obituaries
- Silent film era
- Concert reviews
- Historical archives
- Early 20th century Los Angeles

## Historic Obituaries

- [From the Archives: Earth He Loved Reclaims Him. John Muir, Apostle of the Wild is Dead.](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-john-muir-19141225-story.html): 1914 obituary of naturalist John Muir, Yosemite conservation advocate
- [From the Archives: Magician, Harry Houdini, Succumbs](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-harry-houdini-19261101-story.html): 1926 obituary of escape artist and magician Harry Houdini in Detroit
- [Front page: Harry Houdini's death](https://www.latimes.com/la-me-harry-houdinis-death-20151026-htmlstory.html): Historic front page coverage of magician Harry Houdini's 1926 death
- [From the Archives: Face of Great Actress Subtle Even in Death](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-sarah-bernhardt-19230328-story.html): 1923 obituary of legendary French actress Sarah Bernhardt in Paris
- [From the Archives: Dancer Dies From Fall; Isadora Duncan Meets Fate](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-isadora-duncan-19270915-story.html): 1927 obituary of dancer Isadora Duncan's fatal scarf accident in Nice
- [Front page: Isadora Duncan's death](https://www.latimes.com/la-isadora-duncans-death-20141120-htmlstory.html): Historic front page coverage of dancer Isadora Duncan's 1927 death
- [From the Archives: Man of Thousand Faces Takes But One to Grave](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/la-me-lon-chaney-19300827-story.html): 1930 obituary of silent film actor Lon Chaney, Man of Thousand Faces
- [From the Archives: Walter Rothwell, Head Of Orchestra, Stricken](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment/arts/laphil/la-et-cm-la-phil-walter-rothwell-obit-19270313-story.html): 1927 obituary of LA Philharmonic Orchestra conductor Walter Rothwell

## LA Philharmonic History

- [Review: Philharmonic Makes Debut; New Orchestra Raises Tone of Local Music](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment/arts/laphil/la-et-cm-la-phil-review-walter-rothwell-19191025-story.html): 1919 review of LA Philharmonic's debut concert under Walter Rothwell
- [Review: Schneevoigt In Triumph; Initial Concert With Philharmonic Orchestra Brings Immediate Victory for Conductor](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment/arts/laphil/la-et-cm-la-phil-review-georg-schneevoigt-19271029-story.html): 1927 review of conductor Georg Schneevoigt's LA Philharmonic debut
- [From the Archives: Los Angeles' Season of Music Opens Thursday; Philharmonic Orchestra Will Begin New Concert Series Under Artur Rodzinski](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment/arts/laphil/la-et-cm-la-phil-review-artur-rodzinski-19291020-story.html): 1929 preview of LA Philharmonic season opening under Artur Rodzinski

## Optional

- [From the Archives: Passengers. Many From This City Aboard Stricken Liner.](https://www.latimes.com/local/obituaries/archives/la-me-ac-bilicke-19150508-story.html): 1915 coverage of LA passengers aboard the Lusitania including A.C. Bilicke
